differences.native: MySQL deletes each duplicate joined to a same-email keeper with a smaller id.
differences.app: SQLite deletes each Person row for which an EXISTS subquery finds the same smaller-id keeper.
differences.rationale: Both use the identical duplicate-versus-keeper predicate; the correlated form is the SQLite-compatible expression of the MySQL self-join delete.

differences.native: LeetCode observes the mutated Person table after the DELETE statement.
differences.app: The local script selects id and email after deletion so the isolated runner can compare the resulting table; case validation ignores row order.
differences.rationale: The additional SELECT does not participate in deletion and exists only at the app execution boundary.
